problem.text: Requests are often routed to the wrong department, causing delays and manual rerouting by reviewers. There is no measurement of how often this happens, and the process is inefficient.

goals.text: Reduce the time requests sit before reaching the correct team.
Provide reviewers with assistant-generated recommendations for department and priority, including the policy basis.
Ensure recommendations remain advisory, with human confirmation required for routing.
Audit every recommendation and tool used by the assistant, including who asked, when, and what was returned.

requirements.text: The assistant must generate department and priority recommendations for each new request, citing the relevant policy IDs and versions.
Recommendations must remain advisory, requiring reviewer confirmation before routing; no automatic routing is allowed.
The rationale, policy IDs, and versions used for each recommendation must be visible to reviewers.
All recommendations and assistant tool usage must be auditable, recording who asked, when, and what was returned.

outOfScope.text: Automatic approval of any kind is out of scope for this release.
Email notifications to requesters are out of scope for this release.

successMeasures.text: Success will be measured by the share of requests rerouted after triage, with a two-week baseline measurement before the assistant is activated.

epic.title: Assisted Request Triage
epic.summary: Implement an assistant that provides advisory triage recommendations for routing requests, with policy citations, reviewer confirmation, and full auditability.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a new request, When the assistant generates a recommendation, Then the reviewer sees the suggested department, priority, rationale, and policy citations.
Given a reviewer confirms a recommendation, When the confirmation is processed, Then the routing is updated and the action is audited.
Given the assistant is unavailable, When a reviewer opens a request, Then the panel shows an unavailable message and manual routing stays enabled.
Given a request is rerouted after a suggestion, When a reviewer views the suggestion, Then the UI indicates the suggestion is stale.

tasks.title: Generate and Display Triage Recommendations
tasks.description: Implement logic to generate department and priority recommendations for new requests, displaying rationale and policy citations to reviewers.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a new request, When the assistant processes it, Then a department and priority recommendation with rationale and policy citations is generated.
Given a reviewer opens a request, When a recommendation is available, Then the UI displays the suggested department, priority, rationale, and policy IDs/versions.
Given a request with insufficient information, When the assistant cannot determine a department, Then the request is marked for human review and a clarifying question is suggested.

tasks.title: Reviewer Confirmation and Manual Rerouting
tasks.description: Enable reviewers to confirm or reroute recommendations, ensuring no automatic routing occurs without confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a reviewer sees a recommendation, When they confirm it, Then the request is routed as suggested and the action is audited.
Given a reviewer reroutes a request after a suggestion, When another reviewer opens it, Then the UI indicates the suggestion is stale.
Given a reviewer double-clicks to confirm, When the action is processed, Then only one audit entry and one notification are created.
Given a reviewer opens a request, When the assistant is unavailable, Then the panel shows an unavailable message and manual routing stays enabled.

tasks.title: Audit Trail for Recommendations and Actions
tasks.description: Record all recommendations, tool usage, confirmations, and reroutes in the audit log, including user, timestamp, and returned data.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a recommendation is generated, When it is displayed to a reviewer, Then the event is logged with user, time, and data.
Given a reviewer confirms or reroutes a request, When the action is processed, Then the audit log records the user, time, and action taken.
Given an assistant tool is used to look up information, When the lookup completes, Then the audit log records the lookup details.
Given a reviewer opens a request, When the assistant is unavailable, Then the audit log records the manual routing action.

tasks.title: Multilingual and Performance Support
tasks.description: Ensure the assistant and UI support both English and French, and meet agreed performance standards.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a reviewer in Montréal opens a request, When the UI loads, Then all assistant content is available in French.
Given a reviewer in any office opens a request, When the UI loads, Then all assistant content is available in English.
Given a reviewer opens a request, When the assistant responds, Then the response time meets the agreed performance target.
Given a reviewer opens a request, When the assistant is unavailable, Then the UI displays the appropriate message in the user's language.

openQuestions.question: What is the agreed performance target for 'fast' assistant response?
Who is allowed to override a suggestion: only reviewers, or approvers too?
How long should recommendations (not decisions) be retained in the audit log?

conflicts.summary: POL-ROUTE-004 requires expensive requests to go to Finance, but POL-ROUTE-001 says IT owns all computing equipment, regardless of cost. Ben objects to Finance receiving expensive IT requests.
Ava wants automatic routing when the assistant is confident, but Priya and policy POL-GOV-001 require human confirmation for all routing.
conflicts.resolution: The first release will deliver recommendations plus reviewer confirmation only; no automatic routing without a person confirming.

decisions.decision: The first release delivers recommendations plus reviewer confirmation. No automatic routing without a person confirming.
